answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mirror of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The haven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dawn is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
